title: Set up Forgebox
subtitle: Four short steps. You can change everything later in Settings.
loadFailed: Could not read the first-run state.

hidden.remote: This daemon runs on another machine, so its folders, your PATH and the Windows startup entry are not changed from here.
hidden.portable: Portable mode: the root sits next to the app, and your PATH and the Windows startup entry are left alone.
hidden.forced: The root is set by FORGEBOX_ROOT and cannot be changed here.

root.title: Where should Forgebox live?
root.description: Pick the root folder, the folder whose subfolders become sites, and the local domain.
root.rootHint: Tools, configs, data and logs live here. Default: C:/Forgebox.
root.parkedHint: Every subfolder becomes a site: loja turns into loja{tld}.
root.tldHint: Only names reserved for local use: .test, .localhost, .internal, .lan…

tld.syntax: Use letters, digits and hyphens, with dots between labels.
tld.reserved: That suffix is not reserved for local use; pick .test, .localhost, .internal or .lan.

root.applying: Creating the folders and starting the daemon…

stack.title: What will you build?
stack.description: A stack installs the tools it needs. You can add or remove tools later in the Catalog.
stack.emptyDescription: Install nothing now. Pick tools later in the Catalog.
stack.noStacks: The catalog has no onboarding stacks yet; choose Empty and add tools from the Catalog.
stack.planEmpty: Nothing to download: everything is installed.
stack.versionsFailed: Could not list the versions of {tool}.
stack.versionsStale: Showing the cached list: the providers did not answer.
stack.offline: The stack could not be planned. Check your connection and try again.

options.title: Permissions and parity
options.description: Each switch can be changed later. Nothing here runs until you press Install.

path.label: Add Forgebox to PATH
path.description: So php, composer and node work in any new terminal. Only your user PATH changes.

dns.label: Automatic DNS for *{tld}
dns.description: Every site name resolves to this machine without editing the hosts file. It needs one administrator confirmation (UAC), once.

ca.label: Trust the local CA
ca.description: Windows will show a dialog asking to trust the Forgebox certificate authority. Accept it and https://*{tld} opens without a browser warning. It applies to your user only.

autostart.label: Start with Windows
autostart.description: Opens Forgebox in the tray when you sign in.

parity.label: Linux parity mode (case-sensitive)
parity.description: Your projects will behave like on the server. Upper/lower-case mistakes show up here, not in production.

run.title: Setting everything up
run.description: Downloads are verified before they are used. You can skip any item and run its command later.

skipped.elevation: The administrator confirmation was refused, so this was skipped.

result.path: Forgebox entries are on your user PATH. Open a new terminal to use them.
result.dnsNrpt: Windows sends {tlds} to Forgebox through an NRPT rule. Wildcards such as *{tld} resolve.
result.dnsHosts: Windows is not following the NRPT rule ({reason}), so Forgebox lists each site in the hosts file instead. In hosts mode wildcards (*{tld}) do not resolve: only the sites you add do.
result.dnsHostsNoReason: Forgebox lists each site in the hosts file instead of using NRPT. In hosts mode wildcards (*{tld}) do not resolve: only the sites you add do.
result.dnsNone: DNS is on, but nothing routes {tlds} yet. Run the diagnostics.
result.caTrusted: The local CA is trusted for your user.
result.caNotTrusted: The CA was installed, but Windows does not trust it yet.

dnsReason.group_policy_table_present: a Group Policy NRPT table exists and Windows ignores local rules
dnsReason.resolver_probe_failed: the Windows resolver did not answer the probe, maybe a VPN or security agent
dnsReason.resolver_not_on_port53: the Forgebox resolver is not on port 53
dnsReason.nrpt_points_elsewhere: another rule sends the domain to a different server

tips.label: Tip
tips.t1: Each site gets its own PHP version. Change it any time from the site page.
tips.t2: Drop a project folder on this window and Forgebox creates the site for you.
tips.t3: Everything the app does has a forge command. Open the equivalent commands below to see them.
tips.t4: Linux parity catches wrong upper/lower-case file names before production does.

first.title: Your first site
first.description: Drag a folder here, or type its path.
first.dropActive: Drop the folder to create the site
first.remoteHint: The daemon is on another machine: type the folder path as that machine sees it.

commands.title: Equivalent commands
commands.description: The same setup, from a terminal.

settings.title: First steps
settings.description: Run the setup again to change the stack, the DNS, the CA or the PATH.
